name: Five-player dungeon release stays instant during a boss fight
contract: User's decision (ZG report, 2026-11-24): only raid maps hold the dead during a boss fight; five-player
dungeons and Mythic+ keep the instant release. In Magisters' Terrace (map 585, a five-player dungeon whose
instance script registers boss states) Selin Fireheart's encounter (0) is set in progress and a player dies
in Selin's room. Release is not refused: the player is revived at once, away from the body, at half health.
